clockPolicy: Time.captureFramerate60 fixes Unity game delta; Animator Normal automatically advances. Wall clock differs and is logged. No sprite assignment per sampled phase.
rawPolicy: Complete raw GPU PNG sequence is local work QA, intentionally unpublished; selected native captures and derived MP4/montages are published separately.
lifecyclePolicy: Caller hides renderer, disables Animator and clears Sprite at game elapsed >=0.8; source clip alone does not disappear.
